notes:
# v1.4.1 — FreeWebNovel works again

- Fixed: the "certificate failed" error some readers hit on FreeWebNovel is
  gone. The site itself was fine — the problem was a network issue on certain
  connections, where the connection was quietly routed somewhere it didn't
  belong. The app now finds the real site on its own, so pages load normally
  again.
- Fixed: FreeWebNovel novel pages now show their full chapter list once more.
  Opening a title used to fail outright, and long novels could show only a
  short, cut-off list of chapters. Both are corrected, so every chapter is
  listed and reachable.
- Improved: chapter text no longer carries the site's leftover watermark,
  making for a cleaner read.
- Note: no action needed on your part — just update and enjoy.
